title: Lecture 5 — matrix arithmetic
summary: Check matrix dimensions and order before adding, multiplying or transposing.
body:
This study companion follows the published topic outline saved on 2 November. Newer slides and actual classroom coverage have not been checked; it is not a lecture transcript.

Write the dimensions before multiplying. Compute one product entry as a row-column sum, compare AB with BA when both exist, and check how transposition reverses multiplication order. Read Sections 3.1–3.2.

Use the [Module 2 reading guide and recommended exercises](https://canvas.kth.se/courses/65269/files/10687614). Read the worked methods below, attempt the self-checks, then prepare for the [seminar bonus test](/courses/sf1684/concepts/seminar-bonus-points).
